{{RV|type=function

|game1= tkoh
|version1= 1.00

|game2= arma3
|version2= 0.50

|gr1= Map and Markers

|descr= Selects random position within trigger, marker, location area or area defined by array

|s1= param call [[BIS_fnc_randomPosTrigger]]

|p1= param: can be one of:
* [[Object]] - trigger
* [[String]] - marker
* [[Location]] - location
* [[Array]] - array in format [center, distance] or [center, [a, b, angle, rect]] or [center, [a, b, angle, rect, height]]

{{Feature|informative|Be aware that the {{hl|height}} value is ignored.}}

|r1= [[Array]] - random position in format [x,y,z]

|x1= <sqf>marker1 call BIS_fnc_randomPosTrigger;</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_findSafePos]]
}}
